title: Claudinite dashboard descriptor
description: What one pack contributes to the Claudinite dashboard. Data, never code: the page executes nothing from a pack, so everything a contribution can do is declared here in a closed vocabulary the dashboard owns. Lives at packs/<id>/dashboard.json and is found by that path — nothing registers it.

widgets.description: Every figure this pack has. Declared once; the views below select from this list by id, so one figure cannot be described differently on each surface.

repo.description: Widget ids making this pack's card on a repo page, in order.

member.description: The one widget that becomes this pack's mini-card in a fleet member's subrow. Must name a stat, event or window — a list cannot be one line.

deployment.description: Widget ids making a deployment-scope card on a fleet page — the fleet questions no single member answers.

id.description: This widget's name, and the key its value is looked up under in the values file.

kind.description: stat — a fact true now. event — the last time something happened. window — a count of things that happened, always against the window before it. list — the few most recent named things. There is deliberately no shape a growing cumulative total fits: a number that only rises says nothing about today.

noun.description: What the quantity is of, for the composed fleet phrase — '12 reqs in last 2w'. Required in practice by stat and window, which have nothing else to name.

glyph.description: One grapheme rendered ahead of the phrase, for recognition only. It never carries meaning of its own — the phrase must read without it.

source.description: generated — from this pack's own .claudinite/local/dashboard/<pack>.GENERATED.json in the member's tree. latest-release and repo-stars are platform facts the page already reads for every member, so a pack asking for one ships no code at all.
